description: The camera looks along Alghero's sea bastions in the early afternoon. Tall honey-colored limestone curtain walls drop straight into the water, solid and unadorned, with a plain parapet and no wall-walk arcade of arches. One isolated squat tower sits in the curtain, blocky and no taller than the wall, not a tall cylindrical crenellated tower.
